gambits.name: Throat-Hunter
gambits.text:
When selecting a Gambit, the Controlling Player of a Model with the Long Hunt Trait can select Throat-Hunter instead of any others available to that Model.

If this Gambit is selected, the Model's Melee Attacks in this round of the Challenge gain the Breaching (4+) Special Rule (or Shred (6+) if they already have AP 2), and if the opposing Model has any Tactical Status, the Controlling Player gains a +1 modifier to the Focus Roll.

reactions.name: The Choir Answers
reactions.text:
The charge comes in, and is met by the screams of the charging squad's own dead.

Trigger: The Reactive Player may declare The Choir Answers Advanced Reaction when an enemy Unit declares a Charge targeting a friendly Unit with the Silent Choir Trait.

Cost: 1 Reaction Point.

Effect: The charging Unit must make a Cool Check, applying any Fear (X) modifiers. If the Check is failed, it gains the Pinned Tactical Status and the Charge fails.

reactions.name: Moonfall
reactions.text:
The Burning Sky watches the ground beneath its hunters, and anything that arrives there uninvited is struck from orbit.

Trigger: The Reactive Player may declare a Moonfall Advanced Reaction once per battle, when an enemy Unit is placed on the battlefield from Reserves within 18" of a friendly Model with the Burning Sky Trait and the Command or Paragon Sub-Type or Type.

Cost: 1 Reaction Point.

Effect: Resolve one Shooting Attack against the Target Unit with the following profile, as if fired by the Reacting Model: R Unlimited, FP 1, RS 8, AP 3, D 1, Blast (3"), Pinning (1). The Blast Marker does not scatter.

harbinger.name: Silent Choir
harbinger.text:
The war-moon whose hunters speak only in stolen voices. Its Rangda go into battle wearing the screams of everything they have killed, and its thralls have forgotten their own.

Tactica: Models with the Rangda Trait and the Silent Choir Trait increase the value of their Fear (X) Special Rule by 1, to a maximum of Fear (3).

Cost: Models with the Rangda Trait and the Silent Choir Trait reduce their Ballistic Skill by 1. Its hunters are voices, not marksmen.

Advanced Reaction: The Choir Answers.

harbinger.name: Iron Chain
harbinger.text:
The war-moon that took the most worlds and fields the most thralls; its collars are the oldest and the cruellest.

Tactica: Units with the Neural Collars Special Rule and the Iron Chain Trait count as being within 12" of a friendly Rangdan Model while any of their Models is within 18" of one. When such a Unit is Overloaded with the Collar-master Special Rule, its Models also gain a modifier of +1 to their Weapon Skill until the end of the Phase.

Cost: A Unit with the Iron Chain Trait that is Overloaded suffers D3+1 wounds at the end of the Phase instead of D3.

Prime Advantage: Collar-bombs.

harbinger.name: Long Hunt
harbinger.text:
The war-moon that drifts furthest ahead of the others, whose hunters run their prey down across whole continents.

Tactica: Models with the Rangda Trait, the Long Hunt Trait and the Infantry or Paragon Type have the Fast (2) Special Rule.

Cost: If a Unit with the Long Hunt Trait ends its Movement Phase within 12" of an enemy Unit it can see, a Charge must be declared for it in that turn if it is able to declare one.

Gambit: Throat-Hunter.

harbinger.name: Burning Sky
harbinger.text:
The war-moon that hangs lowest over its battles, its guns always aimed at the ground.

Tactica: Weapons with the Shadow Trait used by Models with the Burning Sky Trait have their Range increased by 6" (Unlimited and Template ranges are unchanged), and War-moon Strikes and Barrages they fire scatter half the rolled distance.

Cost: Models with the Rangda Trait and the Burning Sky Trait reduce their Initiative by 1.

Advanced Reaction: Moonfall.
